en.title: Regina Caeli
en.subtitle: Queen of Heaven
en.bodyMd:
> V. Queen of heaven, rejoice, alleluia.
> R. For he whom you did merit to bear, alleluia,
> V. Has risen as he said, alleluia.
> R. Pray for us to God, alleluia.
> V. Rejoice and be glad, O Virgin Mary, alleluia,
> R. For the Lord is truly risen, alleluia.

Let us pray. O God, who gave joy to the world through the resurrection of your Son our Lord Jesus Christ,
grant, we beseech you, that through the intercession of the Virgin Mary, his mother,
we may obtain the joys of everlasting life.
Through the same Christ our Lord.
Amen.
en.source: EWTN, "Regina caeli (O Queen of Heaven)", https://www.ewtn.com/catholicism/devotions/regina-caeli-o-queen-of-heaven-375, retrieved 2026-08-22

la.title: Regina Caeli
la.bodyMd:
Regina caeli, laetare, alleluia,
quia quem meruisti portare, alleluia,
resurrexit sicut dixit, alleluia,
ora pro nobis Deum, alleluia.
la.source: Vie chrétienne (viechretienne.catholique.org), « Regina cæli - En latin », https://viechretienne.catholique.org/prieres/en-latin/640-regina-caeli, retrieved 2026-08-22

fr.title: Regina Caeli
fr.subtitle: Reine du ciel
fr.bodyMd:
Reine du ciel, réjouissez-vous, alléluia,
car Celui que vous avez mérité de porter dans votre sein, alléluia,
est ressuscité comme il l'a dit, alléluia,
priez Dieu pour nous, alléluia.

> V. Soyez dans la joie et l'allégresse, Vierge Marie, alléluia.
> R. Parce que le Seigneur est vraiment ressuscité, alléluia.
fr.source: Aleteia (fr), « Regina Caeli, le chant de l'Église durant le temps pascal », https://fr.aleteia.org/2014/04/28/regina-coeli-laetare-alleluia/, retrieved 2026-08-22 — provisional pending AELF licence, per content/README.md
